evidence: Labeled 'Validation' and refactors CTransaction, the fundamental consensus transaction primitive in src/primitives/transaction.h.
rationale: Encapsulates CTransaction data members behind observer methods as an internal architectural cleanup. While the author notes this aligns with interface-segregation efforts (#35904), they acknowledge it is 'not a prerequisite for the stateless validation library proposed there,' making this an internal refactoring without an immediate functional payoff or hazard retirement.
